blurb: York's Wild Kingdom is a privately owned zoo and amusement park featuring wild animals from around the world and family-friendly rides. Visitors can explore the Butterfly Kingdom exhibit and interact with over 300 parakeets in the Parakeet Encounter. The park promotes education and conservation through its animal exhibits and offers a fun day trip for families.
